title: Controlled Textbook Integration for Projection and A|E Nesting

basis.scope: Prepare controlled textbook integration of the applied 046-049 sequence as a plan-only surface. The basis is documentary and governed, not a request for direct textbook mutation; it preserves RT_core, A/E asymmetry, projection provenance, and the invariant/variant boundary.

core_rule.statement: Textbook integration may add controlled provenance notes and section-targeted cross-references for the applied 046-049 sequence only when each note remains humble, provisional, and RT_core-invariant.

allowed: Add documentation notes for explicit RT rebinding into A/E slots.
Record that A|E distinction preserves asymmetry, not slot symmetry.
Record projection-from-Core as governed provisional induction.
forbidden: Claim all RTs are identical to the Core Expression.

required_repo_changes.description: Add the section-targeted integration plan and edit order.
Add the claim-discipline rules and prohibited escalations for the textbook update.
Add the exact textbook sections that would be edited under controlled integration.

success_criteria: Textbook update plan names exact sections to be edited.
Each proposed edit traces to applied governance sources.
All provisional claims remain labeled provisional.
Patch-gate accepts the integration plan before any textbook edit is made.
non_claims: Does not edit the textbook yet.
Does not claim projection-from-Core is universally true.
Does not claim A/E role symmetry.
Does not claim universal A/E slot occupancy.
Does not promote any governed note to theorem status.
agent_instruction: Create PATCH_PI_RT_CALCULUS_050 as PROPOSED only. Build the execution surface as a plan, not as direct textbook edits. Do not apply until patch-gate returns apply. Do not edit textbook surfaces yet.
